Name: Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Rename
Author: FarmerBriar
Description:
Love hot chocolate more than coffee? This mod will bring your favorite warm drink to Stardew Valley. As someone who's not a fan of coffee, I made this mod to rename all coffee-related items to hot chocolate.

[b][size=3]CHANGES:[/size][/b]
This mod changes the following items in the game:
[list]
[*]Coffee → Hot Cocoa
[*]Coffee Bean → Cocoa Bean
[*]Coffee Maker → Hot Cocoa Maker
[*]Triple Shot Espresso → Large Hot Cocoa
[/list]
This mod replaces all coffee in the game. If you want to keep coffee in the game and add hot cocoa as a separate function, I recommend one of these mods as an alternative mod to this one: 
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16159?tab=posts]Hot Chocolate Coffee Alternative[/url] by certifiableGrimalkin
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8354]Cocoa Plant and Chocolate Cooking (JA)[/url] by eorrl
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5061]Hot Cocoa Shop[/url] by penny3 
[/list]
[b][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
As far as I know, this mod is NOT compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2108]Coffee Shoppe[/url] or other coffee functionality mods. If this changes, I'll let you know.


[b][size=3]Note:
[/size][/b]This mod only [b]renames[/b] the items. See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29113]Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Reskin[/url] mod to retexture coffee to hot chocolate!
